references.text: Moses gives detailed instructions that six tribes are to stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, and six tribes on Mount Ebal for the curse, which is the concrete fulfillment of what was predicted in 11:29.
Joshua carries out Moses' command by gathering the Israelites between Gerizim and Ebal, where he reads the blessings and curses from the law.
The blessings to be proclaimed on Mount Gerizim are elaborated here, with promises to those who obey the Lord's commands.
The curses to be proclaimed on Mount Ebal are elaborated here, with warnings to those who do not obey the Lord's commands.
Moses summarizes the choice between blessing and curse, life and death, that the people face at the entrance to the promised land.
The Samaritan woman mentions Mount Gerizim as the place where her ancestors worshipped, showing the enduring significance of this mountain in Jewish-Samaritan tradition.
